notes.title: Introduction
notes.content:
[h3]Hi! Welcome![/h3]

This is introduction of Ka: Keepers & Assassins 
The game is PVP arena developed by a single developer for several years, while the current stage of the game is being prepared for public testing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42712430/0a6503a0c76cb6d6e896f50051e071b99c43fcb4.png[/img]
[h3]Game Logic:[/h3]
Ka: Keepers & Assassins is dark fantasy multiplayer 3rd person battle arena game, 4 players against each other.Collect three crystals in a certain time and get them to the center of the arena, in the meantime it is necessary to find better gear against the opponents.
/currently its 1vs1, P2P only/
 
[h3]Gameplay:[/h3]
The player in the lobby can choose from the "hero" character. After the minimum number of two is reached, the game can begin. Players spawn at random positions. Gear and their keepers are spawned at time intervals, which must be destroyed. There are several places in the arena where such drops are made. Meanwhile, in other places, crystals are also dropped at intervals, which must be obtained in order to win the game. These crystals must be obtained by end of the playing time and bring to the center of the map.
After exceeding the time limit, the "timestriker" starts, which takes the life of every player except for the center area.The player must know the arena, every "hero" function, every gear that drops, be fast and have luck.At the moment, the "hero" has one life, but each of them has hp-regeneration and a quick possibility to escape or hide.
During development, the technique of the game may change, it also depends on the community of players, which will suit them better.

[h3]Features:[/h3]
- Atypical controls
- 4x characters "heroes" (currently 2x) 
- 5x character level up (every interval) (disabled,using XP now 0-5 level up)
- the character has 4x spells,damage,defense,health,mana,stamina(all 3 with regeneration),walk,run(speed)
- 30min. game match time limit (currently 10min.)
- 1x dark arena map
- 50+ gear items (currently 25 items)
- gear stats are strength,vitality,dexterity,inteligence,armor
- 5x drop time interval
- 8x crystal spawn positions (random drop every interval)
- 3x crystal
- 1x center area to prevent timestriker damage
- 14x gear items spawn positions (random drop every interval)
- 4x keepers (AI monsters) 
- 112x keepers spawn positions

[h3]Characters: [/h3]

HeroS is ice & smoke female character
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42712430/4513aec12e0e5be8c7663e0cf50fdd887f6068fd.png[/img]

HeroX is fire & blood male character
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42712430/f8cb0633b723a7057ad3ed83b92fafb83dfe97af.png[/img]

Next 2x characters are already designed and rigged.
